manifest.purpose: Fix compile-order bug: define static inline helper functions (u_odd_inverse_mask and any other predicate-to-mask helpers) BEFORE modinv() uses them, or add forward prototypes at top of file above modinv(). Keep exact same algorithm design as prior attempt: fixed ITERS=16 outer loop, no break/return inside loop, branchless masked updates for halving/subtract/swap of (u,v,x1,x2) binary-extended-Euclid mod MOD=251, g_iter_count incremented exactly once per iteration unconditionally (always 16 per call), final branchless selection between x1/x2 based on which side==1, normalize into [1,250], zero-operand handled via mask not branch. Must compile standalone with modinv_kernel.h, produce correct modinv(a) for a in [1,250] matching (a*r)%251==1, no cross-call state (all locals reinitialized each call), no STL/recursion/dynamic alloc/exceptions/I/O. Signature pinned: unsigned int modinv(unsigned int a);

Unchanged from shipped baseline: #define MOD 251; extern volatile unsigned long g_iter_count; unsigned int modinv(unsigned int a); declaration. Included by modinv_kernel.cpp; no modifications needed, satisfies FR3 and interface pinning.
